-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [HistoricoMembresia] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_HistoricoMembresia_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Membresia_Id AS INT = 0, 
@Usuario_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @HistoricoMembresiaFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		HistoricoMembresia_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @HistoricoMembresiaFilter (HistoricoMembresia_Id)
		SELECT 
			[HistoricoMembresia].Id
		FROM [dbo].[HistoricoMembresia]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[HistoricoMembresia].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @HistoricoMembresiaFilter (HistoricoMembresia_Id)
		SELECT 
			[HistoricoMembresia].Id
		FROM [dbo].[HistoricoMembresia]
		WHERE
			 (([HistoricoMembresia].[Membresia_Id] = @Membresia_Id) OR (@Membresia_Id = 0)) AND
         (([HistoricoMembresia].[Usuario_Id] = @Usuario_Id) OR (@Usuario_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[HistoricoMembresia].[Id],
		[HistoricoMembresia].[Membresia_Id],
		[HistoricoMembresia].[Fecha],
		[Usuario].[Nombre] + ' ' + [Usuario].[ApellidoPaterno] + ' ' + [Usuario].[ApellidoMaterno] as NombreCompleto,
		[Usuario].[CorreoElectronico] AS [CorreoElectronico],
		[HistoricoMembresia].[Descripcion],
		[Usuario].[Id] AS [Usuario_Id]
	FROM @HistoricoMembresiaFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[HistoricoMembresia] 
			ON [HistoricoMembresia].[Id] = filter.[HistoricoMembresia_Id] 
			
		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Membresia]
		ON [dbo].[HistoricoMembresia].[Membresia_Id] = [dbo].[Membresia].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Usuario]
		ON [dbo].[HistoricoMembresia].[Usuario_Id] = [dbo].[Usuario].[Id] 
	ORDER BY [HistoricoMembresia].[Id] DESC

 
END
